# Phantom

> Open-source engineering agent workbench. Copy the blocks below. Do not add flags that are not on this page. `phm docs --agent --json` from the installed binary wins if it disagrees with this file. A zero exit code is not a merge, a release, or permission to spend.

## Install

Requires Node.js 22.15.0 or newer. `phm` and `ashlr` are the same program.

```sh
node --version
npm install -g @ashlr/phantom
phm --version
```

The source tree version is not proof that npm has published that version. Check [GitHub releases](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/releases/latest) before you pin one.

## Commands that print JSON

These read local state. They do not start a fleet.

```sh
phm docs --agent --json
phm mcp list --json
phm mcp doctor --json
phm wire status --json
phm authority status --json
phm authority setup --dry-run --json
phm channels status --json
```

`phm mcp doctor` exits 1 when a required server is down. `phm authority status --json` reports the grant. Autonomy ships dormant and is macOS-only. Status does not turn it on.

## Console

```sh
phm verse --no-open --json
```

Serves http://127.0.0.1:7777/verse/ on loopback. The output includes a read token and a mutation token. Do not publish them.

## MCP: Claude Code

File: `~/.claude.json`, key `mcpServers`.

```sh
phm wire claude --json
```

Or paste:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr-hub": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "ashlr",
      "args": ["mcp"],
      "env": {}
    }
  }
}
```

## MCP: Cursor

File: `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, key `mcpServers`.

```sh
phm wire cursor --json
```

Or paste:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr-hub": {
      "command": "ashlr",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## MCP: Codex

Do not hand-edit `~/.codex/config.toml`. `codex` must be on `PATH`.

```sh
phm wire codex --json
```

That runs `codex mcp add ashlr-hub -- ashlr mcp` after a backup.

## Check the wiring

Restart the editor, then:

```sh
phm wire status --json
phm mcp doctor --json
```

Registration does not prove the server started.

## Read-only fleet MCP

Separate from `ashlr-hub`. This server does not launch work or merge.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "phantom-fleet": {
      "command": "phm",
      "args": ["mcp", "fleet"]
    }
  }
}
```

Call `tools/list`, then `fleet_status` with `{}`. See [FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md](FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md).

## Optional cloud handoff

```sh
phm cloud launch "<task>" --repo owner/name
phm devin connect
phm devin launch "<task>"
```

These do not merge by themselves. See [CLOUD.md](CLOUD.md) and [DEVIN.md](DEVIN.md).

Route hysteresis: see docs/ROUTE-HYSTERESIS.md. Dispatcher pool proposals keep a
60-minute residency; only auth failure or zero quota permits early movement.
Launched jobs never move. At most two moves per six hours; blocked moves log
ROUTE_HOLD. Read accepted trailing-hour moves with phm route explain --json.
